moments.title: The Strokes hit London
moments.blurb: New York indie rock legends The Strokes play two nights in London, kicking off their UK dates this week.

angles.name: Live Music Buzz
angles.copy: The Strokes are in London tonight and tomorrow! Who's heading to see the indie icons live?

angles.name: Monday Night Rock
angles.copy: Monday night in London is looking electric! The Strokes are bringing their signature sound to the capital for two nights. Get involved!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Thom Yorke
moments.blurb: Radiohead frontman and acclaimed solo artist Thom Yorke celebrates his 58th birthday tomorrow, October 7th.

angles.name: Radiohead Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're wishing a very Happy 58th Birthday to the incredible Thom Yorke! What's your all-time favourite Radiohead track?

angles.name: Solo & Band Genius
angles.copy: From Radiohead classics to his captivating solo work, Thom Yorke has shaped alternative music for decades. Happy Birthday for October 7th!

moments.title: BFI London Film Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The prestigious BFI London Film Festival opens its doors tomorrow, October 7th, running until the 18th with premieres and special screenings across the city.

angles.name: Film Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Get ready, film fans! The BFI London Film Festival begins tomorrow, bringing the best of cinema to the capital. What are you hoping to see?

angles.name: Red Carpet Ready
angles.copy: London's about to be buzzing with movie magic! The BFI London Film Festival starts October 7th. Expect big premieres and exciting new films.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruno Mars
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning superstar Bruno Mars turns 41 on October 8th, known for his incredible vocals and electrifying stage presence.

angles.name: Funk & Pop King
angles.copy: Wishing a huge Happy 41st Birthday to the one and only Bruno Mars on October 8th! What's your go-to Bruno track?

angles.name: Musical Talent
angles.copy: From 'Uptown Funk' to 'Leave The Door Open', Bruno Mars consistently delivers hits. Celebrate his birthday this Thursday!

moments.title: Westlife land in London
moments.blurb: Irish pop sensations Westlife bring their 'The Wild Dreams Tour' to London's O2 Arena for three nights, starting October 9th.

angles.name: Pop Nostalgia
angles.copy: Westlife are back in London! Kicking off three nights at The O2 from Friday. Who's reliving their youth with the boys?

angles.name: O2 Takeover
angles.copy: The O2 is about to be filled with classic pop hits! Westlife start their London residency on October 9th. Get ready to sing along!

moments.title: Cheltenham Literature Festival starts
moments.blurb: The renowned Cheltenham Literature Festival begins on October 9th, bringing together authors, poets, and readers for ten days of literary events.

angles.name: Bookworm Heaven
angles.copy: Calling all book lovers! The Cheltenham Literature Festival starts Friday, October 9th. Dive into discussions, readings, and more.

angles.name: Literary Weekend
angles.copy: Planning a cultured weekend? The Cheltenham Literature Festival offers a fantastic line-up from October 9th. Get inspired!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Midge Ure
moments.blurb: Ultravox frontman and Band Aid co-founder Midge Ure celebrates his 73rd birthday on October 10th.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 73rd Birthday to the legendary Midge Ure on Saturday! What's your favourite Ultravox hit or Band Aid memory?

angles.name: Music & Charity
angles.copy: From electronic pioneers Ultravox to co-creating Band Aid, Midge Ure's impact is undeniable. Celebrate his birthday this weekend!

moments.title: New Scientist Live hits London
moments.blurb: The New Scientist Live festival, a celebration of science, technology, health and the environment, takes place at ExCeL London from October 10th to 12th.

angles.name: Science & Innovation
angles.copy: Curious about the future? New Scientist Live is at ExCeL London this weekend (Oct 10-12)! Dive into exciting talks and exhibits.

angles.name: Weekend Learning
angles.copy: Looking for something different this weekend? New Scientist Live offers interactive fun for all ages at ExCeL London!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Daryl Hall
moments.blurb: One half of the iconic duo Hall & Oates, Daryl Hall, turns 80 on October 11th.

angles.name: Soulful Sounds
angles.copy: Can you believe Daryl Hall turns 80 on Sunday?! Happy Birthday to the voice behind so many timeless hits with Oates!

angles.name: Hall & Oates Legend
angles.copy: From 'Rich Girl' to 'Maneater', Daryl Hall's voice is instantly recognisable. Wishing him a fantastic 80th birthday this weekend!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Hugh Jackman
moments.blurb: Actor and singer Hugh Jackman, known for his roles in 'The Greatest Showman' and 'Wolverine', celebrates his 58th birthday on October 12th.

angles.name: Showman's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 58th Birthday to the multi-talented Hugh Jackman on Monday! What's your favourite of his roles?

angles.name: From Stage to Screen
angles.copy: Whether he's singing his heart out or battling bad guys, Hugh Jackman always delivers. Celebrate his birthday on October 12th!

moments.title: Scottish Schools Half Term
moments.blurb: Schools across Scotland begin their October half-term holiday this week, from October 12th to 16th.

angles.name: Holiday Fun
angles.copy: School's out for half term in Scotland this week! Kicking off Monday, October 12th. What are your plans for the break?

angles.name: Family Activities
angles.copy: Enjoying the Scottish half term? We've got the soundtrack to your family adventures all week long!

moments.title: Troye Sivan in London
moments.blurb: Australian pop sensation Troye Sivan plays a highly anticipated show in London on October 13th.

angles.name: Pop Live
angles.copy: Troye Sivan is bringing his incredible live show to London on Tuesday, October 13th! Who's excited for 'Rush'?

angles.name: Midweek Gig
angles.copy: Make your Tuesday night sparkle! Troye Sivan plays London on October 13th. Get ready for an unforgettable performance.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Paul Simon
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Paul Simon, half of the iconic duo Simon & Garfunkel, celebrates his 85th birthday on October 13th.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 85th Birthday to the incomparable Paul Simon on Tuesday! What's your favourite track from his incredible career?

angles.name: Iconic Songwriter
angles.copy: From Simon & Garfunkel to his groundbreaking solo work, Paul Simon is a true musical poet. Celebrate his birthday on October 13th!
